source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Calendar helper and every existing caller now await countLoginsAsync, so the task finishes each count check before its next action. The changed shared Assert.equal still has no message; all callers inherit that diagnostic gap. The OAuth token-clear test instead keeps a nonempty message for its persisted-login count and separate memory-token assertions. This patch adds asynchronous ordering, not new authentication coverage or a fresh test result.
title: Calendar login-count checks await each state boundary but still lack a failure message
